title: Fund Matters Using a European Whole-Fund Distribution Waterfall

## Qualifying Matters

### 1. Matter 1003-00002 — Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP
C&H served as **fund formation counsel** for Harrowgate Capital Partners LLC in forming Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP (HPE Fund V) and its related vehicles (the "Fund Complex"). The fund uses a **European-style whole-fund distribution waterfall** (20% carry over an 8% preferred return, with an 80/20 GP catch-up).

**Governing LPAs:**
- **lpa-fund-v-initial-draft.docx** and **lpa-fund-v-revised-draft.docx** — Agreement of Limited Partnership of Harrowgate Private Equity Fund V LP (main fund; Section 8.2 sets forth the European-style, whole-fund waterfall)
- **lpa-parallel-fund.docx** — Agreement of Limited Partnership of Harrowgate Fund V Parallel LP (Section 6.2 employs a European-style whole-fund distribution waterfall)
- **lpa-offshore-feeder.docx** — Exempted Limited Partnership Agreement of Harrowgate Fund V Offshore SLP (Section 6.2 describes the European-style whole-fund distribution waterfall)

### 2. Matter 1004-00002 — Cobalt Life Sciences Opportunities Fund I, LP
C&H serves as **fund counsel** for Cobalt Ventures LP in the structuring, formation, and fund-raising of Cobalt Life Sciences Opportunities Fund I, LP (CLSO Fund I). The fund uses a **European / Whole-Fund Waterfall** (20% carry over an 8% preferred return with a 100% GP catch-up).

**Governing LPA:**
- **clso-fund-i-lpa-first-draft.docx** — Agreement of Limited Partnership of Cobalt Life Sciences Opportunities Fund I, LP (Section 6.2 sets forth the European / Whole-Fund Waterfall)
